title: Sparse Federated Echo State Networks for Time-Series Classification via Smooth-L1 Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2610.21742v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Echo State Networks (ESNs), as lightweight implementations of reservoir computing, provide efficient solutions for temporal data processing in resource-constrained environments. While standard ESNs offer computational efficiency, their dense readout layers inflate the stored model and the per-sample inference cost. This paper introduces a Smooth-L1 regularized ESN (SL1ESN) that promotes sparsity in the readout layer while preserving differentiability for gradient-based optimization. The method employs a twice-differentiable Smooth-L1 approximation compatible with Newton's method, which we exploit both for centralized training and for a second-order (Newton-step) federated aggregation scheme. Under a single fixed shrinkage threshold shared by every dataset and both settings, experiments on seven time-series classification benchmarks show that SL1ESN learns readouts that are $77$--$95\%$ sparse in the centralized setting and $75$--$95\%$ s

translated_title: 基于Smooth-L1正则化的稀疏联邦回声状态网络时间序列分类方法
translated_abstract: 回声状态网络（ESN）作为储备池计算的轻量级实现，为资源受限环境中的时间数据处理提供了高效的解决方案。虽然标准ESN具有计算效率优势，但其密集的读出层会增加存储模型的大小和逐样本的推理成本。本文提出了一种Smooth-L1正则化的ESN（SL1ESN），在保持基于梯度优化的可微性的同时，促进读出层的稀疏性。该方法采用二次可微的Smooth-L1近似，与牛顿法兼容，我们将其既用于集中式训练，也用于二阶（牛顿步）联邦聚合方案。在所有数据集和两种设置下共享单一固定收缩阈值的情况下，在七个时间序列分类基准上的实验表明，SL1ESN学习到的读出层在集中式设置中稀疏度达到77%–95%，在联邦设置中达到75%–95%。
tldr: 本文提出基于Smooth-L1正则化的稀疏回声状态网络SL1ESN，利用与牛顿法兼容的可微稀疏化方法实现读出层高度稀疏，并支持二阶联邦聚合，在七个时间序列分类基准上达到75%–95%的稀疏度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SL1ESN, a Smooth-L1 regularized Echo State Network that achieves highly sparse readout layers via a twice-differentiable regularization compatible with Newton's method, enabling second-order federated aggregation and attaining 75–95% sparsity across seven time-series classification benchmarks.
